remarks: Welcome to 7 Seir Hill Rd #6! Step into this beautiful, well-maintained condo and be greeted by a cozy living room with a fireplace. The main floor features a kitchen with newer stainless steel appliances, a half bathroom, and a dining area.  Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedrooms with high ceilings and large windows, each with its own private full bathroom. The upper level also includes a laundry area with a new washer and dryer, along with plenty of closet space throughout.  Conveniently located within walking distance of the Merritt 7 train station and just minutes from major highway CT-15. Recent updates include a newer roof and windows.
